fullSource:
use IO.Std.write_line
use System.Text.Encoding

let subjects = ["møøse", "𝔘𝔫𝔦𝔠𝔬𝔡𝔢", "J̲o̲s̲é̲"]

for subject in subjects do
    write_line(
        "{subject}: {Encoding.utf8.get_byte_count(subject)} bytes in UTF-8, "
        "{Encoding.unicode.get_byte_count(subject)} in UTF-16")
od
output:
møøse: 7 bytes in UTF-8, 10 in UTF-16
𝔘𝔫𝔦𝔠𝔬𝔡𝔢: 28 bytes in UTF-8, 28 in UTF-16
J̲o̲s̲é̲: 14 bytes in UTF-8, 18 in UTF-16
